content.short: Zebec is a blockchain platform for real-time streaming crypto payroll, payments and spending cards.
content.description: Zebec is a multi-chain payments protocol best known for real-time streaming payroll, where employers continuously stream wages to workers instead of paying in fixed cycles. Around this it has built an ecosystem for crypto payments, stablecoin payroll, Zebec Cards for spending, a consumer super app and DePIN projects. Originally launched on Solana, Zebec now integrates more than 20 chains including Solana, Algorand and Stellar, and its ZBCN token is used for staking and governance through a DAO. Serving over 250 enterprise clients and tens of thousands of monthly users with around 500 million dollars in annual payroll volume, it targets companies and workers who want programmable, continuous payments and faster access to pay.
